scientific_reports_source.title: Use of machine learning to enhance detection of transient astronomical phenomena in historical observatory images

code_availability_check.paper_statement: The paper/preprint identifies this repository as the location of the final machine-learning script.
code_availability_check.interpretation: The paper supplies a code location, but that location is not currently retrievable in this audit. Repository unavailability does not invalidate the paper; it blocks direct code-level replay from the cited URL.
code_availability_check.forbidden_inference: Do not claim the original ML implementation has been reproduced from source code while the cited repository is unavailable.

closed_cohort_byte_gate.reason: The peer-reviewed article reports cohort-level methods and results, but this pass did not locate the exact 107875 row-level candidate+score table required for a byte-auditable TOPA harmonization run.

what_is_public_but_not_equivalent_to_clo.input: Public POSS-I / DSS plate imagery and plate metadata
what_is_public_but_not_equivalent_to_clo.equivalence_guard: Public plates are not the same object as the authors' selected 107875 candidate rows plus their trained ensemble scores.

what_is_public_but_not_equivalent_to_clo.role: Open comparator cohort with explicit opportunity accounting.
what_is_public_but_not_equivalent_to_clo.equivalence_guard: 122511 open candidates / 312 observed nights are not the closed 107875 cohort.

paper_method_elements_safe_to_encode_wit.reported_calibration_behavior: Isotonic calibration was attempted by the authors and collapsed the score distribution; the published analysis therefore used raw mean ensemble scores.
paper_method_elements_safe_to_encode_wit.topa_policy_difference: TOPA keeps raw scores immutable. Any future calibrated representation is a separately named sidecar and is never allowed to overwrite the raw score distribution.
paper_method_elements_safe_to_encode_wit.reproduction_guard: Encoding a methodological pattern is not reproduction of the original model, weights, candidate table, or trained state.

frozen_input_obligations_before_real_cro.requirement: Acquire the exact 107875 candidate identifiers/dates and raw ensemble scores, or explicitly construct an independent replacement cohort and label it RECONSTRUCTION rather than CLOSED_ORIGINAL.
Build an observation-opportunity denominator for every closed-cohort date from frozen plate/usable-area/patch provenance. Candidate presence must never substitute for observing opportunity.
Freeze one exact paper-matching U.S. above-ground nuclear-test manifest with raw bytes and SHA-256 before looking at harmonized effect sizes.
Reconcile 370 reported closed observation dates against 312 JANUS JPFM observed nights and run the mandatory intersection arm.

If the original VASCO-ML code cannot be recovered, any TOPA reimplementation must be versioned as an independent reconstruction and its training labels/features/splits/model state exported to JSON/JSONL receipts.

allowed_next_runs: Replay JANUS open candidates under the exact paper-matching frozen nuclear calendar once that manifest is acquired and hashed.
Build a closed-cohort opportunity reconstruction from public plate metadata if exact candidate dates/plate identities become available.
Independently reconstruct the described artifact-classification architecture while keeping it epistemically separate from the original VASCO-ML implementation.
Search for an archived or forked copy of the paper-named VASCO-ML repository and verify its provenance before use.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not treat the harmonization engine self-test as empirical POSS-I evidence.
Do not invent 107875 rows from summary statistics.
Do not convert p=0.024 into a probability that the nuclear hypothesis is true.
Do not call raw ML scores calibrated probabilities.
Do not pool incompatible opportunity units merely to obtain a combined p-value.
Do not absorb a nuclear/UAP interpretation into the artifact classifier.
